steps.content: Lichen's hands flash through a rapid series of seals, her fingertips dancing with practiced precision. From her sleeves, thunder paper talismans tear through the air, each one finding its mark square in the foreheads of the lunging specters.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Sky overturns, earth submits; drive the thunder, race the clouds... Break!
Thunderclaps rupture the swarm in rapid succession, each blast a hammer of light against the dark. The phantoms scream as their forms unravel, their shadows bleeding away under the relentless glare.
When the last echo fades, only the acrid scent of scorching remains, hanging heavy in the air. Sparks of lightning, scattered and dying, flicker one final time before surrendering to the mist.
Lichen stands frozen, her chest rising and falling in quick, shallow breaths. At the far edge of her vision, the figure waits—still, shrouded, wreathed in thin mist.
Her throat moves. A swallow, small and quiet. Then a step. Another.

Her fingertips meet the mist. They gray instantly, as though the color itself is bleeding out of her. One more step and she crosses over. One more step and her wish is fulfilled. But every instinct in you screams:
—Don't let them meet!

You grab her sleeve, mind racing for words to hold her back. But if words fail, you have one last resort: the Prohibition. All this time, you've been drawing on the Mania seeping from the Void of Yin, channeling power desperately to release the shackles. Pouring everything you have into stopping her.
And now, in a way you never wanted, your wish is coming true.
[White Flash]
Clink—!
A crisp, resonant chime of one copper coin suddenly rings out from deep within the mist.
Bzzzz— Clank, clank—

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: This sound... It's...!!
A deep lurch runs through the earth, as though the ground itself is being pulled by countless dragging chains. From far below, a grinding chorus rises, iron singing its slow, terrible song.

The mist parts, torn asunder, and from the rift steps a figure clad in ancient bronze. Chains trail beneath its feet. Upon its back, a coffin rests. The thing is ink-black, bound in red threads, covered in paper talismans that seem to writhe.
What is this now...?!
It moves toward you. Each step is a labor. Its spine bends low, almost to breaking, crushed beneath a weight it was never meant to carry. And yet it continues. It has no other way.

steps.speaker: Coffin Ghost
steps.content: Ohhh... ohhhhh...

A muffled roar forces its way up from somewhere deep within the monstrosity. It raises one enormous hand, palm streaked dark red and black, fingers thick as roots. Lichen stands forgotten. The hand closes around the masked figure's neck in the mist, gripping tight.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: —Stop!
She raises her hand. From above, swords of living lightning rain down, each one piercing the dark specter's body with blinding precision.
[White Flash]
It wails, a sound that tears through the air, and staggers backward, wounded. But through it all, that massive hand never once loosens its grip on the silent figure it holds.

The mist recoils, surging away to reveal what it had hidden: a dark, profound rift, yawning like a wound in the world. One by one, the malevolent entities are dragged back, pulled back to wherever they came from.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Wait! Let her go!!
Lichen!
You lift your foot to move, and the world stops. A voice, ancient and deep, rises from the depths of your own mind. Each syllable falls like a hammer. Each blow cracks something inside your skull.
Mmph—!
Reality ripples. Through the distortion, Lichen's form reforms, and for a heartbeat, she wears that face. That mask.
Then the fragmented words emerge. They drift loose on the air like scattered petals, until they gather into a single, screaming line of red before you.

<color=#dg1f1f><size=60>Offer no glance to the departed.
Lend no ear to the abyss.
Speak no question to the spirits.</color></size>
